hypotheses.statement: A source-linked draft reduces operator review time without increasing wrong approvals
hypotheses.experiment: Randomized source-linked versus unlinked drafts with independent task labels
hypotheses.falsifier: No review-time reduction or more wrong approvals

hypotheses.statement: Retrieval caching keyed by corpus version improves median latency without stale answers
hypotheses.experiment: Compare uncached and version-keyed caching across corpus revisions
hypotheses.falsifier: No latency improvement or any stale answer
hypotheses.investment: One cache adapter and controlled replay experiment

hypotheses.statement: An LLM planner can improve task utility while preserving exact-payload approval
hypotheses.experiment: Add a proposal-only adapter; independently label task utility and run the same effect-boundary tests
hypotheses.falsifier: No utility improvement or any unauthorized effect
hypotheses.investment: A provider adapter plus a labeled holdout set
